kernel_manifest.qualification: MD5/SHA-256 source identity, binary segment coverage and same-source CSPICE evaluator agreement only; no released chart accuracy claim

numerical_conventions.stations: geocentric airless apparent tropical true-ecliptic/equinox of date, TT
numerical_conventions.vectors: geometric ICRF TDB km and km/s

reference_interpolant: C2 not-a-knot cubic spline; continuous first/second derivatives

source_attribution.direct_offset_interpretation: Total = parent geocentric difference + direct physical-offset difference - reference-chain offset mixing; component maxima are not additive uncertainty bounds
source_attribution.horizons_context_warning: Horizon direct centre/parent/SSB queries may select differing SPK chains. Measured query-context gaps are explicitly retained rather than assigned to centre-offset error.
source_attribution.identity: Aria centre minus Horizons centre = (Aria parent geocentric minus Horizons parent geocentric) + (Aria direct offset minus Horizons effective offset), at identical TDB epoch

uncertainty_register.closure_requirement: Qualified evaluator residuals and source hashes
uncertainty_register.evidence_interpretation: Pinned SPKs, evaluator and full regression checks; not physical truth

uncertainty_register.closure_requirement: Applicable observational covariance or validated physical bounds per body/epoch
uncertainty_register.evidence_interpretation: Component attribution includes differing correlated trajectories; no sigma or model ranking

uncertainty_register.closure_requirement: Independently matched chain and frame/source identity
uncertainty_register.evidence_interpretation: Direct centre, parent and SSB paths may select different chains; direct centre-to-parent queries isolate offset mixing

uncertainty_register.closure_requirement: Validated interpolation/quantisation bounds or direct source brackets for each claim
uncertainty_register.evidence_interpretation: Finite cubic/derivative step agreement is not a rigorous continuous bound
Separate code paths share ERFA IAU 2006/2000A; source correction conventions remain explicit

uncertainty_register.closure_requirement: Independent numerical quantisation analysis with declared source formatting
uncertainty_register.evidence_interpretation: Printed RA/Dec digits do not establish physical accuracy; differentiation can amplify quantisation

uncertainty_register.closure_requirement: P2 civil-time/EOP evidence and per-request assumptions
uncertainty_register.evidence_interpretation: Geocentric TT station evidence does not qualify UTC, UT1, EOP or birth-time uncertainty

uncertainty_register.closure_requirement: Owner approval of metrics, conventions, intervals and claim wording
uncertainty_register.evidence_interpretation: D07 comparison criteria are distinct from absolute physical uncertainty
